metadata.title: The Founder's Ledger
metadata.premise: Team Emberclaw, a franchised adventuring crew, has one night to steal the Founder's Ledger from Wyrmhold Tower before headquarters uses it to dissolve every independent franchise. The tower was designed by a retired adventurer who built it specifically to stop heists like this one.
metadata.narrationVoice: A wry corporate-noir narrator who treats franchise bureaucracy with the same gravity as ancient prophecy, layering dry humor over genuine heist tension.

contentLimits.note: No children appear on-screen in danger or otherwise.

beats.title: The Midnight Contract
beats.prose: Your franchise crew, Team Emberclaw, licensed under the Wyrmhold Consolidated banner, has one night to steal the Founder's Ledger before headquarters uses it to dissolve every independent franchise, including yours. The tower that holds it was designed by Corvin Aldermast, a retired adventurer who built the place specifically to stop crews like yours. Dawn seals the new vault forever.
beats.readAloud: The contract lies open on the table: one signature, one impossible building, one night.

options.label: Track down Aldermast's estranged apprentice
Bribe a Wyrmhold records clerk for intel
Skip the prep and move on the tower now

beats.title: The Apprentice's Grudge
beats.prose: Mira Thistlewood once drafted blueprints beside Aldermast before he cut her out of the firm entirely. She still keeps copies of everything and is happy to help anyone who might embarrass her old mentor.

options.label: Ask about secret maintenance passages
Ask about the guard rotation schedule
Ask for leverage against the night auditor

beats.title: A Willing Clerk
beats.prose: Dez, a mid-level records clerk, is drowning in franchise paperwork and more than willing to trade secrets for a fat purse of gold.

options.label: Buy the maintenance blueprints
Buy the vault's failsafe code
Buy a guard's willingness to look away

beats.title: Wyrmhold Tower at Midnight
beats.prose: The tower rises over the district, its facade a maze of gargoyles that are actually alarm wards. The annual Ledger Audit gala is winding down inside, giving you one last window before the doors seal.

options.label: Slip in through the loading dock
Walk in with the departing gala crowd
Bribe the valet for a service entrance key

beats.title: The Loading Dock
beats.prose: Crates of enchanted quills and ledger-stock paper block the service entrance. A single guard watches the door, half-asleep.

options.label: Time your entry using the known guard rotation
Pick the loading dock lock
Force the door open

beats.title: The Audit Gala
beats.prose: Franchise executives mingle beneath crystal chandeliers, toasting a night that will end several careers by dawn. Blending in is easy; staying unnoticed is not.

options.label: Mingle and drift toward the private stair
Charm a passing auditor for a keycard
Stage a distraction near the dessert table

beats.title: Aldermast's Atrium
beats.prose: Aldermast built the atrium as both showcase and trap: mirrored floors, listening statues, and a spiral stair that only certain footsteps trigger. The vault lies three floors up, past the night auditor's desk.

options.label: Slip through the secret passage
Bluff past the night auditor at the front desk
Walk past the bribed guard's post

beats.title: The Night Auditor
beats.prose: Auditor Presque Voss guards the stair with a ledger of her own: appointments, complaints, and a suspicious eye for anyone dressed slightly too well for midnight.

options.label: Pitch her a franchise proposal to buy time
Hint that you know about her expense reports
Slip past while the alarms are already blaring

beats.title: The Founder's Vault
beats.prose: The vault door is a puzzle-lock of interlocking gears, each keyed to a franchise crest. Aldermast built it to punish haste and reward patience, or insider knowledge.

options.label: Carefully disarm the pressure-plate mechanism
Use your insider knowledge to bypass the lock
Force the vault open loudly

beats.title: Guards in the Corridor
beats.prose: Your misstep echoes through the marble halls, and Wyrmhold security converges fast, blades drawn and boots pounding.

beats.title: The Vault Guardians Awaken
beats.prose: Aldermast's signature constructs, hollow suits of enchanted armor, rise from alcoves around the vault door, animated by the alarm you just tripped.

beats.title: The Ledger in Hand
beats.prose: The Founder's Ledger hums against your palms, bound in dragonhide and stitched with every franchise contract ever signed. What you do with it next will outlast the night.

options.label: Destroy the Ledger to free every franchise
Claim the Ledger to elevate your own franchise
Sell the Ledger to your clerk contact's rival buyer

beats.title: Every Franchise Free
beats.prose: You burn the Ledger's binding page by page in the tower's own furnace. Across the region, a thousand independent franchises wake up owning their own contracts for the first time. Team Emberclaw becomes a legend: broke, hunted by Wyrmhold's lawyers, and utterly free.

beats.title: Emberclaw Ascendant
beats.prose: You rewrite the Ledger's terms in your own name. By sunrise, Team Emberclaw controls franchise rights across three provinces. Power suits you, though some nights you wonder who's coming to steal it from you next.

beats.title: Sold to the Highest Bidder
beats.prose: Your clerk contact's rival buyer pays in gold and gratitude. The Ledger vanishes into a new corporation's vaults, and Team Emberclaw retires rich, if a little uneasy about what they've unleashed.

beats.title: Caught in Aldermast's Design
beats.prose: The building does exactly what its architect intended: it holds you until Wyrmhold security arrives in force. Team Emberclaw's franchise license is revoked before the sun rises, and Corvin Aldermast, watching from a courtyard, allows himself a small, satisfied smile.
